newsitem.title: UK: BZW hires DMG's Schmidt as debt head.
newsitem.headline: BZW hires DMG's Schmidt as debt head.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Britain's Barclays Plc said on Tuesday it had appointed Roman Schmidt, head of German capital markets at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, as its global head of debt syndicate.

BZW said Schmidt would join on May 1. It said he had spent six years at Deutsche Bank and had previously worked at CS First Boston in London, where he was responsible for all fixed income mark trading.

Schmidt will report to Robert Morrice, co-head of European fixed income and head of credit business in Europe. Morrice said Schmidt's appointment was key in the development of BZW's global markets capability.
